title: Neighborhood pet-sitting marketplace (reordered pitch)
idea: We're launching in Jakarta high-rises only, and we don't have an insurance partnership yet — owners waive liability in-app before they book. Sitters keep 80% of the fee and we take 20%, and a new sitter's first three bookings are free. What makes it work is that the sitter is a verified neighbor: someone in the same apartment complex or neighborhood, screened with a government ID and a video intro. Owners open the app when they need last-minute dog walking or pet sitting and book whoever is a few floors away.
focus_notes: Take-rate vs neighbor disintermediation (go off-app after intro)
